title.zh: 被子植物来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Angiospermae to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开被子植物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Angiospermae time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的被子植物时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Angiospermae and Monocotyledones through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较被子植物与单子叶植物；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the 135 Ma Angiospermae display boundary to inspect the 2026 non-pollen fossil calibration model and its stated crown-age sensitivity.
description.zh: 打开被子植物 135 Ma 的显示边界，检查 2026 年非花粉化石校准模型及其明确的冠群年龄敏感性。

limitations: The routed 135 Ma age is the rounded atlas navigation boundary, not the modelled 152.99–151.46 Ma crown interval. The calibration dataset contains non-pollen fossil occurrences and does not establish a pollen occurrence, a fossil locality, a global FAD or a direct ancestor.

description.en: Open a Barremian map context for more than 1,000 Montsechia vidalii specimens from freshwater limestones, linked to the angiosperm range and specimen claims.
description.zh: 打开 Montsechia vidalii 的巴列姆期地图语境，检查 1,000 多件淡水灰岩标本及其关联的被子植物范围和标本声明。

limitations: The 128 Ma route is display context within the source's older 130–125 Ma Barremian conversion. The sampled leafy axes and closed single-seeded fruits support a submerged freshwater interpretation for Montsechia only, not angiosperm ancestral ecology, a global range or a direct ancestor.

description.en: Open the approximately 115 Ma Crato Formation context for Cratolirion bognerianum, whose roots through reproductive organs are linked to the monocot range claim.
description.zh: 打开约 115 Ma 的克拉图组语境，检查从根到生殖器官均有保存的 Cratolirion bognerianum 及其关联的单子叶植物范围声明。

limitations: The 115 Ma route is an approximate fossil anchor for the Crato specimen, not the origin or global FAD of monocots. Its crown-monocot placement is analytical and does not fix a living-family assignment or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open the 124 Ma Lower Yixian Formation context for Leefructus mirus and its dated 125.8–122.6 Ma bed, linked to the eudicot range claim.
description.zh: 打开 Leefructus mirus 的 124 Ma 下义县组语境，检查其 125.8–122.6 Ma 的定年层位及关联的真双子叶植物范围声明。

limitations: This dated bed supports a specimen-level Early Cretaceous eudicot assignment. It does not establish Ranunculaceae affinity, a global eudicot FAD, crown divergence, continuous occupancy or a literal ancestor sequence.

description.en: Open the 66 Ma Lameta Formation context to inspect diagnostic grass phytolith morphotypes in central-Indian dinosaur coprolites, linked to the Poaceae range claim.
description.zh: 打开 66 Ma 的 Lameta 组语境，检查印度中部恐龙粪化石中的诊断性禾草植硅体形态及其关联的禾本科范围声明。

limitations: The 66 Ma map age is within the rounded 67–0 Ma navigation anthology. The microscopic coprolite phytoliths support a locality-bounded grass interpretation, not a complete grass body plan, body-fossil FAD, exact crown origin or global distribution.

title.zh: Corral Bluffs 豆科果实样本

description.en: Open the 65.35 Ma Corral Bluffs context for the Fabaceae fruit and associated leaflets, linked to the family range claim.
description.zh: 打开 65.35 Ma 的 Corral Bluffs 语境，检查豆科果实及关联小叶化石与其科级范围声明。

limitations: The route is bounded to the dated Corral Bluffs fruit and leaflets. It does not fix crown-Fabaceae age, fossil subfamily placement, direct ancestry or continuous global occupancy.
